title: Lesson 38 - Design and Governance for Cross-System Reference: Source of Truth, Sync versus Query, Permissions, and Duplication
description: Explain how to reference Data 360 data from other systems., focused on the design and governance consequences of cross-system reference: which system is the source of truth, sync versus query, permissions, and the pitfalls of duplicating unified data.

questions.question: Which statement describes the source-of-truth relationship between Data 360 and the source systems?
options: Data 360 overwrites source records with reconciled values
Source systems stay authoritative for their own records, and Data 360 is the system of reference for the unified profile and computed insights
The source systems are deleted after unification
Copy field enrichments make the org the source of truth
questions.explanation: Unification links records and never overwrites them, so sources remain authoritative for their raw data while Data 360 references the unified and computed views, and copied values do not transfer authority.

questions.question: An architect needs a Data 360 value live on a record page with no local copy. Which approach matches that requirement?
options: A copy field enrichment that syncs on a schedule
A related list enrichment that reads the DMO through its lookup
A nightly export into a custom object
questions.explanation: A related list reads Data 360 data live through its lookup, so no local copy is created, while a copy field, an export, and a layout change all either duplicate the value or fail to surface Data 360 data.

questions.question: Which is the primary governance risk of copying unified data into org fields?
options: The copies diverge from the source and do not inherit Data 360 field-level security, so they can mislead users and expose sensitive data
questions.explanation: Copies drift from the source and carry only the destination field's own security, which risks both wrong values and exposure, while copying does not stop identity resolution, refund credits, or delete the unified profile.
